audience: support teams that chat with customers in Channel Talk

useCases.title: Review open customer chats
useCases.text: List the customer chats by state and time range, then read the messages of one chat.

useCases.title: Look up a customer by member id
useCases.text: Get a customer by your own member id or by user id, and list the chat tags of the channel.

useCases.title: Route a chat to a manager
useCases.text: List the managers and groups, then assign one customer chat to a manager.

useCases.title: Send a reply to a customer
useCases.text: Read one chat, then send a plain-text reply, only when the user asks for it. The customer sees it at once.

useCases.title: Close a resolved chat
useCases.text: Read one customer chat, then close it. Closing a chat that is already closed has no further effect.
